metadata.notes: Built by scripts/build_model.py from evidence E-001..E-014 (14 files; Concerto build 2026.08.9968-main). 'With AMO' status excluded: user-declared non-Vanilla addition. Safe read-only discovery complete (list-level crawl of all 43 tabs; Action configurator + 9 further Add/Edit configurators inventoried). Controlled EXPERIMENT phase not started. GUIDs referenced via model/IDENTITIES.json are environment-specific observed identities, not portable keys.

sharedConfiguration.statement: Helpdesk Types are exactly Reactive and Planned; one Helpdesk admin page with 43 configuration tabs serves both.
Statuses 'Closed' and 'Cancelled' are single records shared by both Helpdesk Types (returned by both Type filters).
The 9 operative statuses are common to both Type filters (shared, or the filter does not apply — U-003).
No action has any operative-status relationship and nothing auto-fires on status expiry in Vanilla (Action map renders zero such edges; Operative status column blank on all 50 actions).
Action map warnings: 'New PPM' and 'Business Case - R' are unreachable — no live action moves jobs into them (system's own validation; anomaly vs drawn edges recorded as U-007).
8 action groups exist: Reactive Helpdesk Tasks, Planned Helpdesk Tasks, General Mobile, Lead Mobile, Mobile Reactive, Mobile Planned, General Actions, Tag/Auto Actions.
Helpdesk job types tab defines the two Types with per-type job-creation default actions: Reactive→RH01 (default type), Planned→PH01.

Rule/automation surfaces are EMPTY in Vanilla: Status rules, Helpdesk rules, Appointment rules, Action routes/Overrides, Email rules, Quote rules, plus Approvers, Areas, Assignees, Audit bandings, CAPEX codes, FM task types, Hubs, Non working days, Notes/Warnings, SLA fail reasons, Short titles, Trading affected.
SLA table (Response categories): P1 2h/1d, P2 24h/3d, P3 48h/5d, P4 72h/7d, Planned 0/0, By agreement 0/0 — all on 'Standard hours' (Mon-Fri 08:30-17:30); no default flagged (VI-005).

A parallel quote workflow exists: 1 process ('Standard process'), 8 RE-actions, 5 quote-request statuses, 2 quote statuses, 2 categories, 3 priorities. Its bridge back to job statuses is unevidenced (U-005).
20 typed tags (Helpdesk/Order/QuoteRequest) mirror the order-status and T-action vocabularies; actions can add/remove tags and be order-status-triggered (RH04 triggers on 'Awaiting acceptance').
